advantages.title: Stable abrasive performance
advantages.body: Products are produced with medium-frequency induction furnaces, centrifugal atomization, secondary quenching, tempering, rounding, screening and packaging.

advantages.title: Testing-led quality control
advantages.body: Fatigue life testing and direct-reading spectrometer analysis support batch consistency, chemical composition control and SAE-aligned quality.
